$description: Component-scoped token defaults — the third level of the primitive → semantic → component ontology. These are the values a skin overrides through the platform dimension; declaring them here rather than as inline var() fallbacks means the default lives in one place instead of being repeated at every call site.

skin-switch-track-w.$description: Switch track width; overridden by every OS skin.

skin-switch-pad.$description: Inset between thumb and track edge.
